summary: First-run E2E frontend testing of AIOps Transformation OS (frontend-only React app with HashRouter, Zustand store, 15 modules). Verified initial routing/redirect, theme toggle, persona switcher (all 8), sidebar collapse, navigation to all 15 routes, and interactive flows for Maturity, Observability, Incident MTTR, Automation Discovery, Predictive, ITIL, ROI Calculator, Executive Reports (PDF download), Personas activation, and mobile menu sheet. 39/40 assertions passed with ZERO console/page errors across all 15 routes.

ui_bugs.issue: Per-option data-testid like 'question-mon_1-option-4' (referenced in the test request) is NOT present on RadioGroupItem/Label. Only the wrapper has data-testid='question-mon_1'. Tests must click via 'label[for="mon_1-N"]' instead. Functional behavior (gauge updates, radar updates, reset) works correctly when clicked via label.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Add data-testid={`question-${q.id}-option-${idx}`} to each RadioGroupItem (or its Label) in /app/frontend/src/pages/MaturityAssessment.jsx around line 146-154 to match the testid convention referenced in the test plan. Currently only the question wrapper has a testid; individual options are not directly addressable by testid (workaround: label[for='${q.id}-${idx}']).
critical_code_review_comments: App is well structured: HashRouter + DashboardLayout wraps all 15 routes, ThemeBoot syncs 'dark' class on <html> from Zustand persisted store.
All 15 page modules use data-testid attributes consistently for interactive elements.
No console errors emitted on any of the 15 routes — clean implementation.
Reports module wires real jsPDF download (verified actual file 'quarterly-transformation-review.pdf' was downloaded).
Mobile sheet menu (Sheet from shadcn) opens and lists all nav items at 390x844 viewport.
test_credentials: None required (no auth in this app).
seed_data_creation: None — app uses static data files under /app/frontend/src/data/*.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified flows: (1) '/' redirects to '/command-center' (Transformation Manager default persona). (2) All 8 KPI cards render with data-testid='kpi-<id>'. (3) Theme toggle flips html.dark class. (4) Persona switcher dropdown exposes all 8 persona-option-<id>; selecting persona-option-cio navigates to /command-center. (5) Sidebar collapse takes width from 260 -> 76px and back. (6) All 15 sidebar nav items navigate and render their pages without errors. (7) Maturity: gauge updates 0/100 -> 7/100 on answering one mon_1 option (use label[for='mon_1-N']); Reset clears back to 0/100. (8) Observability: select-cloudModel dropdown and switch-k8s toggle both work. (9) Incidents: slider-automation-target updates kpi-savings ($449,935 -> $736,258). (10) Automation: unchecking check-auto-1 reduces kpi-savings-yr ($426,880 -> $379,776). (11) Predictive signal-p2 clickable. (12) ITIL itil-tab-change clickable. (13) ROI: roi-input-tickets-/-month $8.94M -> $14.91M annual savings. (14) Reports: generate-pdf-btn triggers real PDF download. (15) Personas: activate-cio navigates to /command-center. (16) Mobile menu shows full nav inside sheet. Zero console errors throughout all flows. Only minor gap: per-option data-testid missing on Maturity radio items.
rca of the issue: MaturityAssessment.jsx renders each RadioGroupItem with id={`${q.id}-${idx}`} but no data-testid attribute. The wrapper div has data-testid='question-${q.id}'. Tests targeting [data-testid='question-mon_1-option-N'] fail because no such attribute exists. Workaround: click the associated label via 'label[for="mon_1-N"]' — gauge and radar update correctly. Fix: add data-testid={`question-${q.id}-option-${idx}`} to either the RadioGroupItem or its Label.
